expect_red: an assembly with no feature of its own is one labelled outline and no box, a nested one an outline inside it, an outline crossing two districts or inside one has no note, and the assembly's own dimension runs under its parts' boxes

mutations.contract: An assembly with no feature of its own is drawn as its outline and has no box (VA.mapOutlined), so its parts need places of their own and nothing sits in a cell it does not have.
mutations.note: Reads no assembly as an outline: the box-less assemblies fall back to the old rule, have no place, and the map says so -- the outline the handoff adds is gone.

mutations.contract: An assembly's dimension between two of its parts' features runs straight only where that crosses no box, else on a lane past the boxes it spans.
mutations.note: Keeps only the straight try: the jumper runs from race to race through the link body's box.
